dict.string: Attune transcribes your meeting's audio on this Mac. The recording never leaves the device.
Attune captures the audio from your meeting apps on this Mac so it can be transcribed locally. The recording never leaves the device.
Attune captures the audio from your meeting's video conferencing app on this Mac. Only audio is read; the screen contents are not stored.
Attune reads your calendar to suggest the people you meet with and to detect when meetings start. Calendar data stays on your Mac.
Attune reads your contacts so it can suggest who to invite to your workspace. Contacts stay on your Mac.
Attune writes meeting action items to a Reminders list you choose. Reminders stay in your iCloud account, not on Attune's servers.
Attune coordinates with system events to detect when your video-conferencing app starts a call and offer to capture it.
Attune does not use your location.
